thread:
Anika: Quick kickoff 1 1 We need a lean 1-pager + launch post + webinar invite for the secure on-prem offering. Audience: compliance buyers, platform AEs, and field enablement. Must cover SLAs, data residency, inbound routing, and a clear CTA (workshop + webinar).

Leo: I can draft 3 hero lines and a short subhead. Thinking concise: control performance, meet residency.

Priya: I9ll own benchmark numbers and a compact visual (1-slide stat block). Need latest quantized L2-13b runs. Which CSV is the source?

Ben: AE one-pager + 3 qualifying Qs here. Also I9ll set up HubSpot form fields and routing rules. Proposed fields: `deployment_need` (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), `must_have_compliance` (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA), `data_residency_region`, `priority_sla` (checkbox).

HubSpotBot: config: form `secure-deploy-interest` created -> tracking tag `secure_deploy_2026` :white_check_mark:

Priya: Perf snapshot (prelim): hosted p50 ~85ms (8k seq), dedicated p50 ~65ms; p95 hosted ~140ms, dedicated ~110ms. Cost delta: hosted ~$48 per 1M tokens, dedicated ~$34 per 1M tokens (quantized run). Will footnote test harness and workload shape.

LegalBot: Quick note: avoid absolute uptime guarantees in marketing copy. "SLA-backed" is fine if we link to SLA doc. Add short compliance blurb: "Supports SOC2 and ISO-aligned controls; on-prem deployments can meet additional regulatory requirements."

Anika: Good call. Keep benchmark claims factual with footnotes. Priya 1 include a one-line recommended use-case mapping: Hosted=fast POC, Dedicated=steady production, Private=regulated workloads.

Leo: Hero options: 1) "Predictable inference for regulated products." 2) "Control performance. Preserve compliance." 3) "Serve models with SLAs, residency, and routing." Leaning to option 1.

Ben: Routing rules draft: if `deployment_need` == `Private` OR `must_have_compliance` contains `HIPAA` -> route to Enterprise AE queue and notify SEs. If `priority_sla` checked -> tag `urgent-sla` and notify on-call AE. Add hidden `utm_campaign` for tracking.

Priya: Visual idea: single row per deployment mode with 3 metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, recommended scale/use-case. I'll produce a PNG mock and a text table for the one-pager.

Anika: Webinar: propose Tue 11am PT (preferred) or Fri 10am PT. Format: 25m demo + 20m workshop Q&A. CTA: "Schedule a secure deploy workshop" (calendar link) and a shorter "Join the webinar" RSVP.

Leo: Draft launch post angle: lead with a short stat (e.g., "Up to ~1.4x lower token costs on Dedicated vs Hosted for sustained workloads"), then feature bullets (SLAs, routing, residency), then CTA. Will keep tone field-ready.

Ben: I'll wire HubSpot: form -> AE routing rules -> AE queue mapping -> Slack notify channel `#field-routing`. Will add mapping doc in Confluence.

LegalBot: Approved copy template for compliance blurb: "Redwood supports SOC2 and ISO-aligned controls. Private/on-prem deployments are available for customers with strict data residency or regulatory needs. See enterprise terms for SLA details."

Priya: Will draft the stat block and include the exact test conditions: dataset size, sequence length distribution, tokenization, and quantization profile.

Anika: Owners & deadlines: Leo = launch post + hero copy, Priya = benchmark slide + footnote, Ben = HubSpot form + AE one-pager + routing doc, LegalBot = compliance snippet. Deadline: EOD two days from now so we can review on Thursday field sync.

HubSpotBot: campaign created -> `utm_campaign=secure-deploy-2026`; form fields deployed.

Ben: I'll pilot the routing with two AEs next week and report back.

Priya: Sharing a first-pass table in the doc later today.

Anika: Thanks everyone. Keep messages short here if you hit blockers. I9ll schedule the Thurs review and add the doc links. :calendar: :rocket:
